operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SECTION 1. This order shall constitute a finding in pursuance of section 101(b) of the Defense Production Act of 1950, as amended, with respect to the exercise, as directed by section 2 of this order, of the powers vested in me by section 101(a) of that Act.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 2. The officers of the Government in whom are vested (by or pursuant to Executive Order 10480, as amended), the allocation and priorities powers of the Defense Production Act of 1950, as amended, shall exercise those powers to accomplish the transportation and delivery of such persons and things as they deem necessary or proper to promote the national defense, including the accomplishment of military requirements, governmental functions, defense production and measures essential to the public health and safety.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 2

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 3. Notwithstanding any other provision of this order or any other order:

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 3 (lead-in)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (1) The Secretary of Transportation is directed to determine, with the concurrence of the Director of the Office of Emergency Planning, the proper over-all apportionment and allocation of available transportation capacity.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 3(1)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (2) The Secretary of Transportation, subject to the general policy guidance of the Director of the Office of Emergency Planning,, shall exercise centralized direction in the use of transportation priorities to accomplish the purposes of this order.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 3(2)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (3) The Secretary of Transportation shall provide the organization and procedures to carry out the functions under the foregoing provisions of this section.

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 4. This order takes effect at once and shall remain effective until the resumption of rail service makes it unnecessary but in no event more than fifteen days after the termination of the current railroad strike.
